usageNotes: Permanently deletes a named snapshot from a remote QEMU VM managed through PDM. The operation is asynchronous — it returns a remote UPID that must be polled for completion before assuming the snapshot is gone. Requires Resource.Manage on the remote guest; if the target node is not specified, PDM selects it automatically, but passing 'node' is recommended when the remote cluster has multiple nodes to avoid routing ambiguity.

examples.summary: Delete a pre-upgrade snapshot from a remote VM

destructiveReason: Permanently removes the named snapshot and all associated memory/disk state; this cannot be undone.
tips: Poll the returned UPID via the PDM task API to confirm deletion completed before proceeding with dependent operations.
Snapshots with child snapshots (created after this one) may need to be deleted in reverse chronological order depending on the storage backend.
snapname must begin with a letter or digit and match the pattern [A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9._-]* (max 40 chars) — verify the exact name with a list-snapshots call first.
